standard: ISO 26262:2018 Part 8 §7, IEC 61508-3:2010 Annex B, AEC-Q100 FMEA
note: RPN = Severity(1-10) x Occurrence(1-10) x Detection(1-10). ASIL from ISO 26262 Part 3 HARA.

failure_modes: Message not delivered to matching subscribers
Duplicate delivery to same subscriber
entries.local_effect: Subscriber misses or double-processes a message
entries.system_effect: Vehicle signal update lost or duplicated; incorrect actuator state
entries.severity_rationale: Lost signal in a safety loop can delay hazard detection
entries.occurrence_rationale: Wildcard matching is well-tested; regression unlikely
entries.detection_rationale: 12 unit tests cover all delivery paths
entries.mitigation: Full §4.7 wildcard test suite; peer-shared broker test; CI gate

failure_modes: Retained message not stored
Retained message not delivered to new subscriber
entries.system_effect: Stale or absent initial state in vehicle subsystem
entries.severity_rationale: Initial-state miss may cause incorrect startup action
entries.occurrence_rationale: Retained logic is simple; coverage is good
entries.mitigation: mock_integration::mock_retained_delivery; stored in Mutex map before broadcast

failure_modes: Subscribe after close does not return error
Back-pressure policy not applied
entries.local_effect: Caller may block indefinitely or lose messages silently
entries.system_effect: Thread or async task deadlock; undetected message loss
entries.severity_rationale: Deadlock in async task affects system responsiveness
entries.occurrence_rationale: AtomicBool closed check on every call
entries.mitigation: Closed state checked atomically; back-pressure applied per policy in SubRecord::push

failure_modes: Close not atomic — concurrent publish racing close returns neither Ok nor Err
entries.system_effect: Possible panic or data race in vehicle software
entries.severity_rationale: Panic in safety-critical task is catastrophic
entries.detection_rationale: concurrent_close_safe test; no panic under stress
entries.mitigation: AtomicBool::swap with SeqCst; no unsafe; all senders dropped atomically

failure_modes: False positive match — message delivered to wrong subscriber
False negative — message not delivered to intended subscriber
$SYS topic matched by bare # or +
entries.system_effect: Wrong vehicle subsystem receives signal; system-topic flood to user subs
entries.severity_rationale: Wrong routing of brake or throttle signals is safety-critical
entries.occurrence_rationale: Logic is a direct §4.7 port; 10+ edge case tests
entries.detection_rationale: 20+ unit and integration tests covering all §4.7 cases
entries.mitigation: 10 unit tests in topic module, match_topic_conformance relay vector, system_topic_no_hash integration test

failure_modes: relay.Message not converted to mqtt.Message correctly
Back-pressure not applied in forwarding task
entries.local_effect: Incorrect QoS or topic on delivered message
entries.system_effect: Signal lost or misrouted across RELAY crossbar
entries.severity_rationale: Cross-protocol signal loss in vehicle bus
entries.mitigation: Golden-vector round-trip test; relay interop CI job; meta key mapping tested

failure_modes: CONNACK not validated — non-zero return code accepted as success
Connect timeout not enforced
entries.local_effect: Client operates in disconnected state believing it is connected
entries.severity_rationale: Silent loss of all messages — catastrophic
entries.occurrence_rationale: CONNACK validated in run_read_loop; timeout via tokio::time
entries.detection_rationale: Broker integration test verifies connect; timeout test
entries.mitigation: CONNACK return code checked; non-zero returns ConnectionRefused(code); connect_timeout enforced

failure_modes: Oversized payload not rejected — varint encoding overflows
Malformed packet sent — parsing error at broker
entries.local_effect: Broker disconnects; all subsequent messages lost
entries.occurrence_rationale: Max payload check in publish path
entries.mitigation: Payload length checked against MQTT max; varint encoding tested; 6 packet unit tests

failure_modes: Inbound packet with malicious length fields causes OOB read
Truncated packet causes panic on slice index
entries.occurrence_rationale: All slices are bounds-checked; no unsafe
entries.mitigation: No unsafe; all slice accesses use checked operations; malformed → Protocol error

failure_modes: Broker panics on malformed packet from test client
Retained message map grows without bound
entries.local_effect: Integration test broker crashes; test hangs
entries.system_effect: No system effect — broker is test-only; not deployed
entries.occurrence_rationale: Broker only used in integration tests
entries.mitigation: Test broker; errors logged and connection dropped; retained map bounded by test scenarios

failure_modes: mqtt.qos meta key missing or wrong value
mqtt.retained meta key missing
entries.local_effect: RELAY adapter uses wrong QoS; retained state lost across RELAY layer
entries.severity_rationale: QoS downgrade could cause message loss
entries.occurrence_rationale: Explicit key insertion; golden vector tested
entries.mitigation: Explicit BTreeMap insertion for both keys; tested against canonical golden vector

failure_modes: QoS restored incorrectly from meta string
Topic empty after conversion
entries.local_effect: Wrong QoS delivered; Topic-empty error on publish
entries.system_effect: Message dropped by broker due to bad QoS or empty topic
entries.occurrence_rationale: QoS parsed with try_from; empty topic checked
entries.mitigation: QoS parsed via QoS::try_from; unknown values default to AtMostOnce; empty topic returns Err

failure_modes: Subscription recv returns None prematurely (channel dropped)
Unsubscribe does not stop delivery
entries.system_effect: Signal monitoring task terminates; hazard goes undetected
entries.occurrence_rationale: mpsc channel lifetime tied to SubRecord in BrokerState
entries.detection_rationale: mock_publish_subscribe verifies receipt; no explicit unsubscribe-stop test
entries.mitigation: Channel sender held in SubRecord; unsubscribe removes SubRecord; channel close signals None

failure_modes: RELAY sentinel mapping returns wrong variant
Error variant added without updating RELAY mapping
entries.local_effect: RELAY framework misclassifies error; wrong retry policy applied
entries.system_effect: Incorrect fault recovery in vehicle bus bridge
entries.severity_rationale: Wrong retry policy is recoverable but wastes time
entries.occurrence_rationale: Explicit match arms; clippy catches non-exhaustive match
entries.mitigation: Exhaustive match via clippy; all sentinels tested; CI enforces -D warnings

failure_modes: DropOldest implementation drops the new message instead
Block policy causes deadlock in single-threaded context
entries.local_effect: Wrong message retained under back-pressure; potential deadlock
entries.severity_rationale: Incorrect data in vehicle state machine
entries.occurrence_rationale: Policy logic is simple; each branch tested
entries.mitigation: Three back-pressure policies tested independently; Block spawns task to avoid deadlock
